info.title: carbium account API
info.description: Run a carbium account by API. With an account API key (c_acct_...): service keys and their policies, webhooks, usage and telemetry; a key cannot buy, upgrade or cancel anything. With a session (a wallet signature or an e-mailed code): the same, and buying, renewing and closing the account. Docs: /docs/account-api-keys

servers.description: the dashboard name this file was read from

accountApiKey.description: Authorization: Bearer c_acct_... (made on the Account page; shown once)

session.description: Authorization: Bearer <session token>, as POST /v1/auth/wallet or /v1/login/pin/verify answers it; it works on the dashboard name that issued it

BadRequest.description: the body, a query value or a path value is not what the call takes (JSON from the call itself, plain text when a query or path value does not parse)

Unauthorized.description: no valid credential, or a call closed to account API keys

Forbidden.description: the key's access does not cover the call, the caller's address is not allowed, or the account is not active

NotFound.description: no such thing on this account

Conflict.description: the account's state refuses the call; the message says why

Unreadable.description: a JSON body whose fields or types do not fit the call (415 without a JSON content type): the reader's own words, as plain text

TooMany.description: too many calls: back off and retry; wait Retry-After seconds when the answer carries it

Failure.description: any other failure: 500 internal, 503 upstream or unavailable (a store, the ledger or the payment provider is unreachable: retry)
